# claudeblattman (Chris Blattman)

license: `MIT` · 35 skills · last update: 2026-11-18

**Source:** <https://github.com/chrisblattman/claudeblattman>

**Maintainers:** Chris Blattman (University of Chicago, Harris School of Public Policy)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code`

> Claude Code for academics — skills, agents, and setup guides. 367 stars MIT. Listed as a community extension by Pedro Santanna. Mix of research-specific skills (deep-research, proposal-write, review-plan, methodology review) and personal-workflow skills (morning-brief, schedule-query). Refresh 2026-11-24: upstream moved the skills from skills/<name>.md to skills/<name>/SKILL.md and added a starter-kit-source folder. Re-pointed 11 existing skills (checkin, deep-research, post-meeting and setup-project-management have new texts and new descriptions), removed 9 entries whose texts no longer exist upstream (dr-synthesize, prompt-only, prompt-refine, review-plan, tips-bookmarks, pre-meeting-brief and the old council, done and prompt), re-copied the 3 agents, and added 14 skills from skills/ plus 7 from starter-kit-source. Most additions are personal-productivity skills rather than research skills. The plugins/starter-kit-claude and plugins/starter-kit-codex folders mirror starter-kit-source and are not catalogued separately.

**Source YAML:** [`skills/claudeblattman.yml`](https://github.com/bhanneke/RISE/blob/main/skills/claudeblattman.yml)
